verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הַבָּאִ֤ים אֶל־ דָּוִיד֙ לְצִ֣יקְלַ֔ג ע֣וֹד עָצ֔וּר מִפְּנֵ֖י שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־ קִ֑ישׁ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים עֹזְרֵ֖י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hab·bā·’îm ’el- dā·wîḏ lə·ṣî·qə·laḡ ‘ō·wḏ ‘ā·ṣūr mip·pə·nê šā·’ūl ben- qîš wə·hêm·māh bag·gib·bō·w·rîm ‘ō·zə·rê ham·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle
verses.literalPt: Ora, estes são os que vieram ter com Davi a Ziclague, enquanto estava escondido por causa de Saul, filho de Quis; e eram dos homens poderosos que lhe ajudavam na guerra.

verses.original: נֹ֣שְׁקֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת מַיְמִינִ֤ים וּמַשְׂמִאלִים֙ בָּֽאֲבָנִ֔ים וּבַחִצִּ֖ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת מֵאֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל מִבִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: nō·šə·qê qe·šeṯ may·mî·nîm ū·maś·mi·lîm bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ū·ḇa·ḥiṣ·ṣîm baq·qā·šeṯ mê·’ă·ḥê šā·’ūl mib·bin·yā·min
verses.literal: they were archers . . . using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows . . . and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Tinham por arma o arco e usavam tanto da mão direita como da mão esquerda, em arremessarem pedras com fundas e em dispararem setas dos arcos; eram dos irmãos de Saul, de Benjamim.

verses.original: הָרֹ֨אשׁ אֲחִיעֶ֜זֶר וְיוֹאָ֗שׁ בְּנֵי֙ הַשְּׁמָעָ֣ה הַגִּבְעָתִ֔י וִיזוּאֵל וָפֶ֖לֶט בְּנֵ֣י עַזְמָ֑וֶת וּבְרָכָ֕ה וְיֵה֖וּא הָעֲנְּתֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rōš ’ă·ḥî·‘e·zer wə·yō·w·’āš bə·nê haš·šə·mā·‘āh hag·giḇ·‘ā·ṯî wī·zū·ʾēl wā·p̄e·leṭ bə·nê ‘az·mā·weṯ ū·ḇə·rā·ḵāh wə·yê·hū hā·‘ăn·nə·ṯō·ṯî
verses.literal: Ahiezer their chief and Joash who were the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth Beracah Jehu the Anathothite
verses.literalPt: O chefe era Aiezer, em seguida Joás, filhos de Semaá, gibeatita; Jeziel e Pelete, filhos da Azmavete; Beraca e Jeú, anatotita;

verses.original: וְיִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַגִּבְעוֹנִ֛י גִּבּ֥וֹר בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ הַשְּׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ וְיִרְמְיָ֤ה וְיַחֲזִיאֵל֙ וְי֣וֹחָנָ֔ן וְיוֹזָבָ֖ד הַגְּדֵרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiš·ma‘·yāh hag·giḇ·‘ō·w·nî gib·bō·wr baš·šə·lō·šîm wə·‘al- haš·šə·lō·šîm wə·yir·mə·yāh wə·ya·ḥă·zî·’êl wə·yō·w·ḥā·nān wə·yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ hag·gə·ḏê·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty Jeremiah Jahaziel Johanan and Jozabad the Gederathite
verses.literalPt: Ismaías, gibeonita, homem poderoso entre os trinta e comandante deles, e Jeremias, Jaaziel, Joanã e Jozabade, gederatita;

verses.original: אֶלְעוּזַ֤י וִירִימוֹת֙ וּבְעַלְיָ֣ה וּשְׁמַרְיָ֔הוּ וּשְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ הַחֲרִיפִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’el·‘ū·zay wî·rî·mō·wṯ ū·ḇə·‘al·yāh ū·šə·mar·yā·hū ū·šə·p̄aṭ·yā·hū ha·ḥă·rī·p̄ī
verses.literal: Eluzai Jerimoth Bealiah Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite
verses.literalPt: Eluzai, Jerimote, Bealias, Semarias, Sefatias, harufita;

verses.original: אֶלְקָנָ֡ה וְ֠יִשִּׁיָּהוּ וַעֲזַרְאֵ֧ל וְיוֹעֶ֛זֶר וְיָשָׁבְעָ֖ם הַקָּרְחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’el·qā·nāh wə·yiš·šî·yā·hū wa·‘ă·zar·’êl wə·yō·w·‘e·zer wə·yā·šā·ḇə·‘ām haq·qā·rə·ḥîm
verses.literal: Elkanah Isshiah Azarel Joezer and Jashobeam who were Korahites
verses.literalPt: Elcana, Issias, Azareel, Joezer e Jasobeão, coreítas;

verses.original: וְיוֹעֵאלָ֧ה וּזְבַדְיָ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָ֖ם מִן־ הַגְּדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·‘ê·lāh ū·zə·ḇaḏ·yāh bə·nê yə·rō·ḥām min- hag·gə·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor
verses.literalPt: Joela e Zebadias, filhos de Jeroão, de Gedor.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַגָּדִ֡י נִבְדְּל֣וּ אֶל־ דָּוִיד֩ לַמְצַ֨ד מִדְבָּ֜רָה גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל אַנְשֵׁ֤י צָבָא֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עֹרְכֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח וּפְנֵ֤י אַרְיֵה֙ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְכִצְבָאיִ֥ם עַל־ הֶהָרִ֖ים לְמַהֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hag·gā·ḏî niḇ·də·lū ’el- dā·wîḏ lam·ṣaḏ miḏ·bā·rāh gib·bō·rê ha·ḥa·yil ’an·šê ṣā·ḇā lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘ō·rə·ḵê ṣin·nāh wā·rō·maḥ ū·p̄ə·nê ’ar·yêh pə·nê·hem wə·ḵiṣ·ḇā·yim ‘al- he·hā·rîm lə·ma·hêr
verses.literal: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness They were mighty men of valor trained for battle experts with the shield and spear whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains
verses.literalPt: Dos gaditas desertaram para Davi, ao lugar forte no deserto, homens ilustres em valor, preparados para a guerra, que sabiam manejar escudo e lança. Os seus rostos eram como de leões, e eles, tão velozes como as corças sobre os montes.

verses.original: עֵ֖זֶר הָרֹ֑אשׁ עֹבַדְיָה֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֱלִיאָ֖ב הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·zer hā·rōš ‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh haš·šê·nî ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ haš·šə·li·šî
verses.literal: Ezer the chief Obadiah the second in command Eliab the third
verses.literalPt: O chefe era Ezer; o segundo, Obadias; o terceiro, Eliabe;

verses.original: מִשְׁמַנָּה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י יִרְמְיָ֖ה הַחֲמִשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: miš·man·nāh hā·rə·ḇî·‘î yir·mə·yāh ha·ḥă·mi·šî
verses.literal: Mishmannah the fourth Jeremiah the fifth
verses.literalPt: o quarto, Mismana; o quinto, Jeremias;

verses.original: עַתַּי֙ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֱלִיאֵ֖ל הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tay haš·šiš·šî ’ĕ·lî·’êl haš·šə·ḇi·‘î
verses.literal: Attai the sixth Eliel the seventh
verses.literalPt: o sexto, Atai; o sétimo, Eliel;

verses.original: יֽוֹחָנָן֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י אֶלְזָבָ֖ד הַתְּשִׁיעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḥā·nān haš·šə·mî·nî ’el·zā·ḇāḏ hat·tə·šî·‘î
verses.literal: Johanan the eighth Elzabad the ninth
verses.literalPt: o oitavo, Joanã; o nono, Elzabade;

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔יס מַכְבַּנַּ֖י עַשְׁתֵּ֥י עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: yir·mə·yā·hū hå̄·ʿă·śī·rīs maḵ·ban·nay ‘aš·tê ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: Jeremiah the tenth and Machbanai the eleventh . . .
verses.literalPt: o décimo, Jeremias; o undécimo, Macbanai.

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה מִבְּנֵי־ גָ֖ד רָאשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א אֶחָ֤ד לְמֵאָה֙ הַקָּטָ֔ן וְהַגָּד֖וֹל לְאָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh mib·bə·nê- ḡāḏ rā·šê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ’e·ḥāḏ lə·mê·’āh haq·qā·ṭān wə·hag·gā·ḏō·wl lə·’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: These Gadites . . . were army commanders the least of whom was a match for a hundred and the greatest for a thousand
verses.literalPt: Estes, dos filhos de Gade, foram capitães do exército; o que era menor valia por cem homens, e o maior, por mil.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן וְה֥וּא מְמַלֵּ֖א עַל־ כָּל־ גִּדיֹתָיו וַיַּבְרִ֙יחוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָ֣עֲמָקִ֔ים לַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְלַֽמַּעֲרָֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh hêm ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn wə·hū mə·mal·lê ‘al- kāl- gi·ḏ·yō·ṯå̄w way·yaḇ·rî·ḥū ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ă·mā·qîm lam·miz·rāḥ wə·lam·ma·‘ă·rāḇ
verses.literal: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing . . . all its banks and they put to flight all those in the valleys both to the east and to the west
verses.literalPt: Estes são os que passaram o Jordão no primeiro mês, quando ele trasbordava por todas as suas ribeiras; e puseram em fugida a todos os que habitavam nos vales, ao oriente e ao ocidente.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ מִן־ בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ לַמְצָ֖ד לְדָוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū min- bə·nê ḇin·yā·min wî·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- lam·ṣāḏ lə·ḏā·wîḏ
verses.literal: Other Benjamites . . . and some men from Judah also came . . . to David in his stronghold
verses.literalPt: Também vieram dos filhos de Benjamim e de Judá ter com Davi, ao lugar forte.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א דָוִיד֮ לִפְנֵיהֶם֒ וַיַּ֙עַן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם אִם־ לְשָׁל֞וֹם בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַי֙ לְעָזְרֵ֔נִי יִֽהְיֶה־ לִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם לֵבָ֖ב לְיָ֑חַד וְאִֽם־ לְרַמּוֹתַ֣נִי לְצָרַ֗י בְּלֹ֤א חָמָס֙ בְּכַפַּ֔י יֵ֛רֶא אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ וְיוֹכַֽח׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ḏā·wîḏ lip̄·nê·hem way·ya·‘an way·yō·mer lā·hem ’im- lə·šā·lō·wm bā·ṯem ’ê·lay lə·‘ā·zə·rê·nî yih·yeh- lî ‘ă·lê·ḵem lê·ḇāḇ lə·yā·ḥaḏ wə·’im- lə·ram·mō·w·ṯa·nî lə·ṣā·ray bə·lō ḥā·mās bə·ḵap·pay yê·re ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū wə·yō·w·ḵaḥ
verses.literal: And David went out to meet them . . . saying If you have come to me in peace to help me my heart will be united with you but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence may the God of our fathers see it and judge you
verses.literalPt: Davi saiu-lhes ao encontro e disse-lhes: Se vierdes ter comigo pacificamente para me socorrer, unir-se-á o meu coração convosco; se, porém, vierdes para me entregar aos meus adversários, não havendo mal nas minhas mãos, olhe para isso o Deus de nossos pais e seja juiz.

verses.original: וְר֣וּחַ לָבְשָׁ֗ה אֶת־ עֲמָשַׂי֮ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁים לְךָ֤ דָוִיד֙ וְעִמְּךָ֣ בֶן־ יִשַׁ֔י שָׁל֨וֹם׀ שָׁל֜וֹם לְךָ֗ וְשָׁלוֹם֙ לְעֹ֣זְרֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עֲזָרְךָ֖ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וַיְקַבְּלֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּרָאשֵׁ֥י הַגְּדֽוּד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·rū·aḥ lā·ḇə·šāh ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·śay rōš haš·šə·lō·šīm lə·ḵā ḏā·wîḏ wə·‘im·mə·ḵā ḇen- yi·šay šā·lō·wm šā·lō·wm lə·ḵā wə·šā·lō·wm lə·‘ō·zə·re·ḵā kî ‘ă·zā·rə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā way·qab·bə·lêm dā·wîḏ way·yit·tə·nêm bə·rā·šê hag·gə·ḏūḏ
verses.literal: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai the chief of the Thirty, and he said We are yours O David We are with you O son of Jesse Peace peace to you and peace to your helpers for your God helps you So David received them and made them leaders of his troops
verses.literalPt: Então, veio o Espírito sobre Amasai, que era chefe dos trinta, e ele disse: Somos teus, ó Davi, e do teu lado, ó filho de Jessé; paz, paz seja contigo, e paz seja com os que te ajudam, porque o teu Deus te ajuda. Davi recebeu-os e fê-los capitães de tropas.

verses.original: וּמִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֞ה נָפְל֣וּ עַל־ דָּוִ֗יד בְּבֹא֨וֹ עִם־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים עַל־ שָׁא֛וּל לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲזָרֻ֑ם כִּ֣י בְעֵצָ֗ה שִׁלְּחֻ֜הוּ סַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּרָאשֵׁ֕ינוּ יִפּ֖וֹל אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֥יו שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·mə·naš·šeh nā·p̄ə·lū ‘al- dā·wîḏ bə·ḇō·’ōw ‘im- pə·liš·tîm ‘al- šā·’ūl lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·lō ‘ă·zā·rum kî ḇə·‘ê·ṣāh šil·lə·ḥu·hū sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm lê·mōr bə·rā·šê·nū yip·pō·wl ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāw šā·’ūl
verses.literal: Some from Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul They did not help the Philistines because the Philistine rulers consulted and sent David away saying It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul
verses.literalPt: Também de Manassés desertaram alguns para Davi, quando veio com os filisteus contra Saul para pelejar (Porém não os ajudou, porque os régulos dos filisteus, tendo feito conselho, o despediram, dizendo: Ele, com perigo das nossas vidas, passará para o seu amo Saul.).

verses.original: בְּלֶכְתּ֣וֹ אֶל־ צִֽיקְלַ֗ג נָפְל֣וּ עָלָ֣יו׀ מִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֡ה עַ֠דְנַח וְיוֹזָבָ֤ד וִידִֽיעֲאֵל֙ וּמִיכָאֵ֣ל וְיוֹזָבָ֔ד וֶאֱלִיה֖וּא וְצִלְּתָ֑י רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·leḵ·tōw ’el- ṣî·qə·laḡ nā·p̄ə·lū ‘ā·lāw mim·mə·naš·šeh ‘aḏ·naḥ wə·yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ wî·ḏî·‘ă·’êl ū·mî·ḵā·’êl wə·yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ we·’ĕ·lî·hū wə·ṣil·lə·ṯāy rā·šê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm ’ă·šer lim·naš·šeh
verses.literal: When David went to Ziklag these men of Manasseh defected to him Adnah Jozabad Jediael Michael Jozabad Elihu and Zillethai chiefs of thousands in Manasseh
verses.literalPt: Voltando ele para Ziclague, de Manassés desertaram para ele: Adna, Jozabade, Jediael, Micael, Jozabade, Eliú e Ziletai, capitães de mil com Manassés.

verses.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה עָזְר֤וּ עִם־ דָּוִיד֙ עַֽל־ הַגְּד֔וּד כִּֽי־ גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל כֻּלָּ֑ם וַיִּהְי֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים בַּצָּבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh ‘ā·zə·rū ‘im- dā·wîḏ ‘al- hag·gə·ḏūḏ kî- ḡib·bō·w·rê ḥa·yil kul·lām way·yih·yū śā·rîm baṣ·ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: They helped David against the raiders for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army
verses.literalPt: Deram auxílio a Davi contra a tropa de salteadores, porque todos eles eram ilustres em valor e foram capitães no exército.

verses.original: כִּ֚י לְעֶת־ י֣וֹם בְּי֔וֹם יָבֹ֥אוּ עַל־ דָּוִ֖יד לְעָזְר֑וֹ עַד־ לְמַחֲנֶ֥ה גָד֖וֹל כְּמַחֲנֵ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî lə·‘eṯ- yō·wm bə·yō·wm yā·ḇō·’ū ‘al- dā·wîḏ lə·‘ā·zə·rōw ‘aḏ- lə·ma·ḥă·neh ḡā·ḏō·wl kə·ma·ḥă·nêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him until he had a great army like the army of God
verses.literalPt: De dia em dia, concorriam a Davi para o auxiliarem, até que se fez um grande exército como o exército de Deus.

verses.original: וְ֠אֵלֶּה מִסְפְּרֵ֞י רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽחָלוּץ֙ לַצָּבָ֔א בָּ֥אוּ עַל־ דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֑וֹנָה לְהָסֵ֞ב מַלְכ֥וּת שָׁא֛וּל אֵלָ֖יו כְּפִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mis·pə·rê rā·šê he·ḥā·lūṣ laṣ·ṣā·ḇā bā·’ū ‘al- dā·wîḏ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh lə·hā·sêḇ mal·ḵūṯ šā·’ūl ’ê·lāw kə·p̄î Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him in accordance with the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Estes são os números dos cabeças dos que estavam armados para a guerra, que vieram ter com Davi, em Hebrom, para lhe transferirem o reino de Saul, segundo a palavra de Jeová.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נֹשְׂאֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח שֵׁ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh nō·śə·’ê ṣin·nāh wā·rō·maḥ šê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·šə·mō·w·neh mê·’ō·wṯ ḥă·lū·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From Judah . . . 6,800 . . . . . . . . . armed troops bearing shields and spears
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Judá, que traziam escudos e lanças, seis mil e oitocentos, armados para a guerra.

verses.original: מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן גִּבּ֤וֹרֵי חַ֙יִל֙ לַצָּבָ֔א שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמֵאָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: min- bə·nê šim·‘ō·wn gib·bō·w·rê ḥa·yil laṣ·ṣā·ḇā šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mê·’āh
verses.literal: From Simeon . . . 7,100 . . . . . . mighty men of valor ready for battle
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Simeão, homens valentíssimos para a guerra, sete mil e cem.

verses.original: מִן־ בְּנֵי֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: min- bə·nê hal·lê·wî ’ar·ba·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Levi, quatro mil e seiscentos.

verses.original: וִיהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַנָּגִ֣יד לְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wî·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ han·nā·ḡîḏ lə·’a·hă·rōn wə·‘im·mōw šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: including Jehoiada leader of the house of Aaron with 3,700 . . . . . . men
verses.literalPt: Joiada foi o chefe da casa de Arão, e, com ele, três mil e setecentos;

verses.original: וְצָד֥וֹק נַ֖עַר גִּבּ֣וֹר חָ֑יִל וּבֵית־ אָבִ֥יו שָׂרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq na·‘ar gib·bō·wr ḥā·yil ū·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇîw śā·rîm ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: and Zadok a mighty young man of valor with 22 . . . commanders from his own family . . .
verses.literalPt: e Zadoque, mancebo ilustre em valor, e, da casa de seu pai, vinte e dois capitães.

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֧י בִנְיָמִ֛ן אֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְעַד־ הֵ֙נָּה֙ מַרְבִּיתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרִ֕ים מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê ḇin·yā·min ’ă·ḥê šā·’ūl šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·‘aḏ- hên·nāh mar·bî·ṯām šō·mə·rîm miš·me·reṯ bêṯ šā·’ūl
verses.literal: From Benjamin . . . the kinsmen of Saul 3,000 . . . most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Benjamim, irmãos de Saul, três mil, porque até então a maior parte deles se tinham conservado fiéis à casa de Saul.

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה מֵא֑וֹת גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֥י שֵׁמ֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·mō·w·neh mê·’ō·wṯ gib·bō·w·rê ḥa·yil ’an·šê šê·mō·wṯ lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: From Ephraim . . . 20,800 . . . . . . . . . mighty men of valor famous among their own clans . . .
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Efraim, vinte mil e oitocentos, ilustres em valor e de nome nas casas de seus pais.

verses.original: וּמֵחֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִקְּבוּ֙ בְּשֵׁמ֔וֹת לָב֖וֹא לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ דָּוִֽיד׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·ḥă·ṣî maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh šə·mō·w·nāh ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄ ’ă·šer niq·qə·ḇū bə·šê·mō·wṯ lā·ḇō·w lə·ham·lîḵ ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: From the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh 18,000 . . . . . . designated by name to come and make David king
verses.literalPt: Da meia tribo de Manassés, dezoito mil, que foram designados por nome para virem fazer rei a Davi.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר יוֹדְעֵ֤י בִינָה֙ לַֽעִתִּ֔ים לָדַ֖עַת מַה־ יַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רָאשֵׁיהֶ֣ם מָאתַ֔יִם וְכָל־ אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ פִּיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê yiś·śā·š·ḵār yō·wḏ·‘ê ḇî·nāh la·‘it·tîm lā·ḏa·‘aṯ mah- ya·‘ă·śeh yiś·rā·’êl rā·šê·hem mā·ṯa·yim wə·ḵāl ’ă·ḥê·hem ‘al- pî·hem
verses.literal: From Issachar . . . men who understood . . . the times and knew what Israel should do 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Issacar, homens que tinham a inteligência dos tempos, para saberem o que Israel devia fazer, os cabeças deles eram duzentos; e todos os seus irmãos seguiram o seu mandamento.

verses.original: מִזְּבֻל֞וּן יוֹצְאֵ֣י צָבָ֗א עֹרְכֵ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּכָל־ כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְלַעֲדֹ֖ר בְּלֹא־ לֵ֥ב וָלֵֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: miz·zə·ḇu·lūn yō·wṣ·’ê ṣā·ḇā ‘ō·rə·ḵê mil·ḥā·māh bə·ḵāl kə·lê mil·ḥā·māh ḥă·miš·šîm ’ā·lep̄ wə·la·‘ă·ḏōr bə·lō- lêḇ wā·lêḇ
verses.literal: From Zebulun 50,000 . . . fit for service . . . trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war who with one purpose . . . were devoted to David
verses.literalPt: De Zebulom, cinquenta mil, que podiam sair no exército, pôr-se em campo, providos de toda a sorte de instrumentos de guerra, e ordenar a batalha. Não eram de coração dobre.

verses.original: וּמִנַּפְתָּלִ֖י שָׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְעִמָּהֶם֙ בְּצִנָּ֣ה וַחֲנִ֔ית שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min·nap̄·tā·lî śā·rîm ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘im·mā·hem bə·ṣin·nāh wa·ḥă·nîṯ šə·lō·šîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: From Naphtali 1,000 commanders accompanied by 37,000 . . . . . . men with shield and spear
verses.literalPt: De Naftali, mil capitães, e, com eles, trinta e sete mil que levavam escudo e lança.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַדָּנִי֙ עֹרְכֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁמוֹנָ֥ה אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- had·dā·nî ‘ō·rə·ḵê mil·ḥā·māh ‘eś·rîm- ū·šə·mō·w·nāh ’e·lep̄ wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: From Dan 28,600 . . . . . . . . . . . . prepared for battle
verses.literalPt: Dos danitas, vinte e oito mil e seiscentos, que podiam pôr-se em campo.

verses.original: וּמֵאָשֵׁ֗ר יוֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֛א לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ מִלְחָמָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·’ā·šêr yō·wṣ·’ê ṣā·ḇā la·‘ă·rōḵ mil·ḥā·māh ’ar·bā·‘îm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: From Asher 40,000 . . . fit for service . . . prepared for battle
verses.literalPt: De Aser, quarenta mil, que podiam sair no exército e pôr-se em campo.

verses.original: וּמֵעֵ֣בֶר לַ֠יַּרְדֵּן מִן־ הָראוּבֵנִ֨י וְהַגָּדִ֜י וַחֲצִ֣י׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ כְּלֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên min- hā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·hag·gā·ḏî wa·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh bə·ḵōl kə·lê ṣə·ḇā mil·ḥā·māh mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: And from east of the Jordan from Reuben Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh there 120,000 . . . . . . armed with every kind . . . of weapon of war
verses.literalPt: Da banda dalém do Jordão dos rubenitas, dos gaditas e da meia tribo de Manassés, providos de toda sorte de instrumentos de guerra, cento e vinte mil.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִלְחָמָה֮ עֹדְרֵ֣י מַעֲרָכָה֒ בְּלֵבָ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ בָּ֣אוּ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠גַם כָּל־ שֵׁרִ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֵ֥ב אֶחָ֖ד לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh ’an·šê mil·ḥā·māh ‘ō·ḏə·rê ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh bə·lê·ḇāḇ šā·lêm bā·’ū ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh lə·ham·lîḵ ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḡam kāl- šê·rîṯ yiś·rā·’êl lêḇ ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ham·lîḵ ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: All these men of war arrayed for battle came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel And all the rest of the Israelites were of one mind to make David king
verses.literalPt: Todos estes, sendo guerreiros, que sabiam ordenar a batalha, vieram com coração perfeito a Hebrom, para constituir a Davi rei sobre todo o Israel; e todo o resto também de Israel estava de um só coração em constituir rei a Davi.

verses.original: וַיִּהְיוּ־ שָׁ֤ם עִם־ דָּוִיד֙ יָמִ֣ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה אֹכְלִ֖ים וְשׁוֹתִ֑ים כִּֽי־ הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָהֶ֖ם אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū- šām ‘im- dā·wîḏ yā·mîm šə·lō·wō·šāh ’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·šō·w·ṯîm kî- hê·ḵî·nū lā·hem ’ă·ḥê·hem
verses.literal: They spent three days there eating and drinking with David for their relatives had provided for them
verses.literalPt: Permaneceram ali com Davi três dias, comendo e bebendo, porque seus irmãos lhes tinham feito provisões.

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם הַקְּרֽוֹבִים־ אֲ֠לֵיהֶם עַד־ יִשָׂשכָ֨ר וּזְבֻל֜וּן וְנַפְתָּלִ֗י מְבִיאִ֣ים לֶ֡חֶם בַּחֲמוֹרִ֣ים וּבַגְּמַלִּ֣ים וּבַפְּרָדִ֣ים׀ וּֽבַבָּקָ֡ר מַאֲכָ֡ל קֶ֠מַח דְּבֵלִ֨ים וְצִמּוּקִ֧ים וְיַֽיִן־ וְשֶׁ֛מֶן וּבָקָ֥ר וְצֹ֖אן לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam haq·qə·rō·w·ḇîm- ’ă·lê·hem ‘aḏ- yi·śā·š·ḵār ū·zə·ḇu·lūn wə·nap̄·tā·lî mə·ḇî·’îm le·ḥem ba·ḥă·mō·w·rîm ū·ḇag·gə·mal·lîm ū·ḇap·pə·rā·ḏîm ū·ḇab·bā·qār ma·’ă·ḵāl qe·maḥ də·ḇê·lîm wə·ṣim·mū·qîm wə·ya·yin- wə·še·men ū·ḇā·qār wə·ṣōn lā·rōḇ kî śim·ḥāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And their neighbors from as far away as Issachar Zebulun and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys camels mules and oxen abundant supplies of flour fig cakes and raisin cakes wine and oil oxen and sheep Indeed there was joy in Israel
verses.literalPt: Além disso, os que estavam perto, até Issacar, Zebulom e Naftali, traziam em jumentos, em camelos, em machos e em bois, pão, comidas de farinha, pastas de figos, cachos de passas, vinho, azeite, bois e ovelhas em abundância, porque havia regozijo em Israel.
